# OmniStacks Digital

> OmniStacks Digital (OSD) builds SaaS websites and iOS and Android mobile apps, then grows them with social media marketing. The website is an interactive 3D studio: every object on the desk opens a page.

## What we do

- SaaS websites: marketing sites, pricing pages and onboarding for SaaS products, built to be fast, findable and to turn visitors into signups.
- Mobile apps: iOS and Android apps, cross-platform where that helps and fully native where it matters, shipped through the App Store and Google Play.
- Social media marketing: strategy, content and paid campaigns on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and X, measured in signups and installs rather than likes.

## Selected work

- Banafee Group: bilingual corporate website for a Malaysian halal food group (https://www.banafeegroup.com).
- FitPlanCoach: fitness web app, designed and engineered end to end (https://www.fitplancoach.com).
- Clovey Kitchen: mobile-first restaurant website.
- KAIA Dubai Chewy: vertical launch reel for Instagram and TikTok.
- Banafee brand film: a social brand film for Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube.

## How we work

- Every build is priced after a short discovery call, and the quoted number is the number you pay. Social media is a flat monthly fee.
- A SaaS website usually takes four to six weeks. A first app release takes ten to fourteen. You get a dated plan before work starts.
- A small studio: the people on your first call design, build and grow the product.
- You own the code, the designs, and the store and social accounts, from day one.
